description: A chain span stores input.value as JSON and output.value as text from the mime types.
notes: hand-written from openinference-instrumentation-langchain. The JSON input half is confirmed by openinference/langgraph-agent, whose CHAIN spans (LangGraph, model, tools) have input.mime_type application/json. No capture has a chain span with a text output, so the text output half is not covered.
